test_environment.session: RTH signal/entry/endpoints; full-session detector history; SPY includes extended hours for calendar VWAP.

dataset.provider: Owned Databento OHLCV files listed in offline-provenance; provider inferred from feed filenames, not a fresh download.
dataset.missing_data_treatment: Reject horizons crossing a missing elapsed minute, calendar date or selected-contract change.
dataset.rollover_treatment: MNQ previous available ET-date volume front outright contract; reset on change.

execution.entry_rule: Next bar open after confirmed signal close.
execution.exit_rule: Directional terminal close at declared horizon, not strategy exits.
execution.position_sizing: One MNQ contract or one SPY share for dollar conversion only.
execution.overlap_rule: Within family/side require >10 signal bars between retained events; opposite sides/families can overlap.

costs.description: Historical October 1 cost scenario; doubled cases double total fee+slippage, not just fees. SPY is per one share; MNQ per one contract.
